entries.e0209a312c1c81ce: It is the sole reportable segment of the company group. Under its parent company, G-Communication Co., Ltd. (ownership of voting rights 50.31%; receives financial support and management guidance), the group operates restaurants in formats such as yakiniku, sushi, izakaya, and everyday meals and fast food, through directly operated stores and franchised stores. It has eight consolidated subsidiaries and two affiliates, and as of March 31, 2026, the number of consolidated employees was 719. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.e181dc181e2b2783: For existing formats, the company plans to redesign products, prices and services as one unit, centered on 'mass appeal' and 'casualness', premised on everyday use, and to pursue a strategy of positioning them as volume-zone formats under the keyword 'mass dining'. Domestically, it plans to expand its operating areas and business scale, including through M&A, and overseas, it plans to strengthen store openings mainly in Asia through a franchise chain model and also to expand into new areas such as the United States. It also aims to establish 'next-generation stores' by strengthening the securing and development of personnel and rebuilding store operations through DX.
